read.thesis: Q1 CY26 revenue NT$1,134.1bn (+35.1% YoY) with 66.2% gross margin; Q2 guide US$39.0–40.2bn with gross margin 65.5–67.5%, but release contains no capacity or capex commentary.

triggers.label: Q2 revenue guide US$39.0–40.2bn
triggers.quote: Revenue is expected to be between US$39.0 billion and US$40.2 billion;

triggers.label: Gross margin 66.2% in Q1
triggers.quote: Gross margin for the quarter was 66.2%, operating margin was 58.1%, and net profit margin was 50.5%.

guidance.quote: Revenue is expected to be between US$39.0 billion and US$40.2 billion;
Gross profit margin is expected to be between 65.5% and 67.5%;
Operating profit margin is expected to be between 56.5% and 58.5%.
